topic: Myth: miners can change the 21 million cap
title: Myth: Bitcoin Miners Can Change the 21M Cap
hook: Myth: miners can just raise Bitcoin's twenty-one million cap.

scenes.narration: The issuance schedule is fixed in advance.
Each full node validates blocks with the same consensus rules.
A block that issues more than the rules allow is rejected by the network.
A miner may claim less than the allowed reward, which destroys those coins, but never more.

cta: Does that settle it? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Miners propose blocks, but nodes enforce the rules, including the cap.
